newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as incentives prop up prices.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as incentives prop up prices.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply higher on a lower volume as a result of a package of incentives offered by the central bank to boost the market, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 65.86 points or 4.46 percent at 1,539.7 on a turnover of 150.4 million taka. Gainers led losers by 107 to 18. Brokers said market sentiment turned positive but investors, anticipating more price rise, held back selling as the central bank asked commercial banks to double the credit ceiling to two million taka to investors.
Singer Bangladesh rose 979.95 taka to 10,835.33 and Beximco Pharma gained 7.96 to 224.16.
